name: 02888 · Warwick, RI
findings: ZIP 02888 (Warwick) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02888 (Warwick) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02888 (Warwick) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
